title: The Covenant at Beersheba
description: Abimelech and the commander of his army, Pikol, came to Abraham and asked him to swear an oath of loyalty. Abraham complained about a well that Abimelech's servants had seized by force, and the two made a covenant. Abraham gave seven ewe lambs as evidence that he had dug the well, and the place was called Beersheba. Abraham planted a tamarisk tree there and called on the name of the Lord.
